Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. Spain has fifteen official higher schools of dramatic art, accredited by the education ministry and awarding qualifications recognised at European level, but their specialisms are Acting, Scenography, and Stage Directing and Dramaturgy: no puppetry specialism. The only foothold identified is the Puppets and Objects module taught at Dantzerti, the Basque higher school of dramatic art in Bilbao. A module within an acting course does not satisfy a denominator that requires a specialised training rather than a subject appearing in a curriculum. The previous value of 0.5 was the midpoint of an estimated range. Caveat: this finding rests on search summaries and an encyclopaedic page, without reading the curricula of all fifteen institutions; confidence therefore stays at estimate and the upper bound at 1.

establishments.description: The Basque higher school of dramatic art, one of Spain's fifteen official ESADs. Its puppetry teaching is a module inside an acting curriculum, not a specialism.
